info.title: ClientLedger Trial Balance engine
info.description: Desktop-mode API of the Vibe Trial Balance engine. Every response uses the { data, error, meta } envelope. Amounts are integer cents.

start_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

end_date.description: DATE column, serialized as UTC midnight

ChartAccount.description: One account on a client chart of accounts (the import picks accounts from these, Q37).

TrialBalanceRow.description: One account on the adjusted trial balance (view v_adjusted_trial_balance). Each stage is a debit/credit pair in cents.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file, hex

idMappings.description: Per table, archive id -> restored id

fileName.description: A desktop full backup in BACKUPS_DIR

clientId.description: The client id inside that backup

outName.description: The client .tbak to write in BACKUPS_DIR

TbTotals.description: Column totals of GET /periods/{periodId}/trial-balance, summed by PostgreSQL over the same rows.

ClientSummary.description: One period of an active client, as the Clients screen shows it (Q16).

last_worked.description: Newest change to the trial balance, an entry or a task

expectedUpdatedAt.description: row_updated_at as read; 409 STALE_WRITE when the row changed since

CsvColumnMapping.description: A mapping the user chose (lib/csvColumnMapping.ts); replaces the guess.

csvRow.description: Line index in the file, from 0

fallbackMode.description: The columns were guessed without AI
